theory.title: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto
theory.explanation: Al transmitir una pregunta, usa ask + if/whether para preguntas de sí/no o una palabra interrogativa para preguntas informativas; después, mantén el orden de una oración afirmativa. Para transmitir una petición educada, usa ask + persona + to + infinitivo.
theory.tip: En estilo indirecto, no uses el orden interrogativo: She asked where the office was.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 1
patterns.pattern: The customer asked where the manager was.
examples:
The customer asked where the manager was.
→ El cliente preguntó dónde estaba el gerente.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 2
patterns.pattern: He asked if the order had arrived.
examples:
He asked if the order had arrived.
→ Él preguntó si había llegado el pedido.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 3
patterns.pattern: She asked whether the payment was complete.
examples:
She asked whether the payment was complete.
→ Ella preguntó si el pago estaba completo.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 4
patterns.pattern: The assistant asked what the problem was.
examples:
The assistant asked what the problem was.
→ El asistente preguntó cuál era el problema.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 5
patterns.pattern: They asked me to send the invoice.
examples:
They asked me to send the invoice.
→ Me pidieron que enviara la factura.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 6
patterns.pattern: The manager asked why the delivery was late.
examples:
The manager asked why the delivery was late.
→ El gerente preguntó por qué se había retrasado la entrega.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 7
patterns.pattern: I asked if the shop accepted returns.
examples:
I asked if the shop accepted returns.
→ Pregunté si la tienda aceptaba devoluciones.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 8
patterns.pattern: The customer asked how long the repair would take.
examples:
The customer asked how long the repair would take.
→ El cliente preguntó cuánto tardaría la reparación.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 9
patterns.pattern: She asked us to wait for confirmation.
examples:
She asked us to wait for confirmation.
→ Nos pidieron que esperáramos la confirmación.

patterns.label: Preguntas y peticiones en estilo indirecto · 10
patterns.pattern: He asked when the refund would be processed.
examples:
He asked when the refund would be processed.
→ Él preguntó cuándo se tramitaría el reembolso.

content.passage: A customer called a retailer to ask about a delayed order. The assistant asked for the order number and then asked whether the customer had received an update. The customer wanted to know when the refund would be processed. The assistant asked him to wait while she contacted the supplier. She later explained that the parcel would arrive the next day and asked him to confirm the address.

items.prompt: Report a question a customer might ask about a refund.
items.modelAnswer: When I buy something, I usually compare prices and read the conditions carefully. If there is a problem, I contact customer service and explain what has happened. I think a good company should listen to customers and offer a fair solution. I keep receipts and confirmation emails in case I need them later. Planning purchases helps me manage my budget and avoid unnecessary expenses.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
